summary: Repair budget reached. Returned the best preflight-clean draft, which was not explicitly accepted by the visual reviewer.

feedback.summary: The headline text edit succeeded ("Calmer clinics, faster triage" is present), but the rendered poster is essentially a blank 1080×1350 canvas with three tiny text lines huddled in the lower-left quadrant. The hero image did not resolve (LUME0210 asset bytes missing) so ~60% of the top of the page is empty white, and the type is far too small for the surface — no focal dominance, massive dead band above, and no visible band/scrim/brand structure that a "hero poster" implies. This is not a shippable artifact even though the copy change itself is correct.

issues.message: The `hero` image failed to resolve (LUME0210: asset bytes missing for hero_image) so the top ~60% of the poster is a blank white void. A hero poster with no hero renders as an unfinished draft.
issues.suggested_repair: Restore/regenerate the hero_image asset bytes in the asset store, or replace `hero` with a placeholder brand surface fill (e.g. `#hero fill($surface.brand)` on the image node's parent frame) so the top region is not empty white.

issues.message: The headline renders at ~32pt on a 1080×1350 canvas — it does not dominate. On this surface a hero headline should be ~64–80pt (`$type.size.6xl`/`7xl`) so it reads as the focal point. Currently CASE STUDY, headline, and body all read at nearly the same visual weight.
issues.suggested_repair: On #headline, step the size up: `#headline style($type.headline) font_size($type.size.6xl)` (64) or `7xl` (80), keeping the rest of the node untouched.

issues.message: Massive dead band: the top ~810pt of the page is empty white while all three text lines are stranded in a narrow strip near the bottom-left. The band `translate(0 810)` fills white and its children start at x=24 with a 32pt headline — the composition reads as truncated/unfinished, not intentional.
issues.suggested_repair: Either restore the hero image so the top band is filled, or give the `band` a real fill (e.g. `#band fill($surface.brand)` or `$surface.muted`) and center/scale its content so the poster reads as a finished layout instead of a void with a caption.

issues.message: Text hugs the left edge at x=24 (a 24pt inset on a 1080-wide canvas) with no matching right margin structure. On a 1080-wide poster, content margins should be ~72–96pt to feel intentional.
issues.suggested_repair: Increase left/right padding on the band's content column to ~80pt (e.g. `pad(80)` on the band's autolayout) so the copy sits inside a proper margin.

feedback.repair_instruction: The headline copy change is correct. The design is not shippable because (1) the hero image asset failed to resolve — restore hero_image bytes in the asset store or fall back the `hero` node's parent to a solid brand surface so the top ~810pt is not empty white; (2) the headline is too small — apply `#headline font_size($type.size.6xl)` (64) or `7xl` (80) so it dominates the 1080×1350 canvas; and (3) widen the band's inner padding to ~80pt so the text isn't glued to the left edge. Do not alter the headline string or other copy.
